item.goddess_of_maids.laoda_shard.desc: The rancor of an overlord from a bygone age
item.goddess_of_maids.final_slash.desc1: The count of the blade has come
item.goddess_of_maids.final_slash.desc2: Records damage dealt by the maid; once it exceeds the target's max health, the target is executed (kill credited to the owner)
item.goddess_of_maids.final_slash.desc3: Chaos Book synergy: true damage becomes a slash at the enemy's very essence (credited to the owner); 33 true damage hits without killing marks the execution line
item.goddess_of_maids.final_slash.link_c: Silver Cercis synergy: the true damage she reflects is matched by an extra share, which counts toward the execution total
item.goddess_of_maids.final_slash.desc4: Every 11 seconds, halves the target's health; this strike counts as 6 true damage hits
item.goddess_of_maids.final_slash.desc6: Erase mode may cause abnormal loot drops
message.goddess_of_maids.final_slash.era: Erase mode on: the execution also erases the target
Erase mode off: the execution stops at the killing blow
Erase mode is not allowed on this server
item.goddess_of_maids.guardian_shield.de: No vanish in this world shall pass the shield
Shield only: after falling or being erased, she returns to you as a smart slab
Also with Ultramarine Orb Elixir / Undying Totem: a fall revives her on the spot, unconsumed; an erase still slabs her
Also with an Anchor Core: even an erase no longer disperses her - she revives on the spot
If an anchor that stabilizes reality and the elixir of immortality are given to her as well, her defense seems to reach its peak...
item.goddess_of_maids.devoted_heart.desc: This heart belongs to its master alone
Every creature that would hate the owner turns its hatred to the maid wearing this heart
When the owner strikes or is struck, the maid locks onto that foe (the one the owner struck takes priority)
Guardian Shield synergy: she will block damage for you depending on the distance
item.goddess_of_maids.devoted_heart.shif: Hold Shift for the guard tiers
item.goddess_of_maids.devoted_heart.guar: Within %s blocks: you take no damage
A scroll of deep and mysterious air; it seems to sharpen certain skills in a maid's bauble slot...
The normal slash of the final slash adds a black hole, drawing enemies in and dealing 1% of their current health per tick to anything it touches
On execution it leaves a black hole behind, with some crowd reach
The owner and the owner's maids are spared, as are those she will not strike
item.goddess_of_maids.energy_core.desc1: It seems to use a certain infinite block common in skyblock survival; that endless generation could well serve as fuel for nuclear fusion
item.goddess_of_maids.hover_cannon.desc1: Powered by the Energy Reactor Core, it strikes nearby enemies in bursts
item.goddess_of_maids.hover_cannon.desc2: When enemies crowd around, it can unleash a screen-clearing attack
Strengthens the maid's teleport: the servant bell can recall her across dimensions
death.attack.black_hole: %1$s was torn apart by a black hole
death.attack.black_hole.player: %1$s was torn apart by a black hole while fleeing %2$s
death.attack.hover_cannon: %1$s was torn apart by hover cannon fire
death.attack.hover_cannon.player: %1$s was torn apart by hover cannon fire while fleeing %2$s
item.goddess_of_maids.maid_altar_spawner: Raises a maid altar centered on you
It faces whichever way you are looking
There is no one left who needs it
item.goddess_of_maids.entity_id_copy.mar: Left-click to lock the maid's hatred onto the creature under your crosshair
item.goddess_of_maids.coordinate_display: While held, shows the targeted block's coordinates, your distance to it, and its offset from the bound Relic Control Core
Hold right-click to phase through blocks; mind your flight
block.goddess_of_maids.relic_control_cor: The coordinate origin of a ruin; mechanisms are placed by their offset from it
Place only one per ruin; mechanism events resolve coordinates from the nearest one
item.goddess_of_maids.relic_eye.desc1: Finds an unexplored mossy relic and carries you there
item.goddess_of_maids.relic_eye.linked: The Relic Eye has bound to this relic
item.goddess_of_maids.relic_eye.empty: This relic seems to have been explored already, give it another try~
gui.goddess_of_maids.damned_cause: %s destroyed a container and was torn apart by raging energy
